senses.en: extremely unpleasant or annoying

ex.en: An obnoxious passenger kept shouting into his phone during the flight.
ex.zh: 一個討人厭的乘客在飛行途中一直對著手機大吼。

root.note: 對人造成傷害的 → 令人反感的

senses.en: funeral rites (usually plural)

ex.en: The whole village attended the obsequies for the beloved doctor.
ex.zh: 全村的人都參加了那位受愛戴醫生的葬禮。

root.note: 跟隨靈柩送行 → 葬禮

senses.en: the act of obeying a law, rule, or custom
a ceremony or ritual, especially religious

ex.en: Strict observance of the safety rules prevented any injuries.
ex.zh: 嚴格遵守安全規定，避免了任何人受傷。

root.note: 守著（規定）→ 遵守

senses.en: quick to notice things
carefully following religious laws or customs

ex.en: An observant neighbor noticed smoke and called the fire department.
ex.zh: 一位眼尖的鄰居注意到冒煙，打電話給消防隊。

root.note: 一直注視著的 → 觀察敏銳的

senses.en: a building with telescopes for observing the sky

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from the observatory on the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們在山上的天文台觀看月食。

root.note: 觀看（天空）的地方 → 天文台

senses.en: the process of becoming outdated or no longer used

ex.en: Critics accuse phone makers of planned obsolescence.
ex.zh: 批評者指控手機廠商刻意讓產品提早淘汰。

root.note: 逐漸不再被習慣使用 → 過時

mn: planned obsolescence：計畫性汰舊，故意讓產品很快過時。

senses.en: becoming outdated; going out of use
senses.zh: 逐漸過時的；即將淘汰的

ex.en: Fax machines are obsolescent in most modern offices.
ex.zh: 傳真機在大多數現代辦公室裡已逐漸被淘汰。

root.note: 正在變得不被使用 → 逐漸過時的

mn: obsolescent 是「正在過時」，obsolete 是「已經過時」。

senses.en: no longer produced or used; out of date

ex.en: Floppy disks became obsolete once USB drives appeared.
ex.zh: 隨身碟出現後，磁碟片就被淘汰了。

root.note: 不再被習慣使用 → 過時的

senses.en: a doctor who specializes in pregnancy and childbirth

ex.en: Her obstetrician recommended regular walks during the pregnancy.
ex.zh: 她的產科醫師建議她懷孕期間規律散步。

root.note: 站在（產婦）前面幫忙的人 → 產科醫師

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with pregnancy and childbirth

ex.en: The hospital is known for its excellent department of obstetrics.
ex.zh: 這家醫院以優秀的產科聞名。

root.note: 站在產婦前接生的學問 → 產科學

senses.en: the quality of being stubborn

ex.en: His obstinacy prevented the two sides from reaching an agreement.
ex.zh: 他的固執讓雙方無法達成協議。

root.note: 對著站定不動 → 固執

senses.en: noisy and difficult to control
senses.zh: 吵鬧難管的；不守秩序的

ex.en: The substitute teacher struggled with the obstreperous class.
ex.zh: 代課老師拿那班吵鬧的學生沒辦法。

parts.m: make a noise 發出噪音

root.note: 對著人大吵大鬧 → 吵鬧難管的

senses.en: to block a path or passage
to prevent or hinder progress

ex.en: Do not park in a way that will obstruct the fire lane.
ex.zh: 停車時不要擋住消防通道。

root.note: 對著堆起東西 → 阻擋

senses.en: something that blocks a path or passage
the act of hindering, especially a legal process

ex.en: Workers removed a fallen tree that was an obstruction on the highway.
ex.zh: 工人移走了一棵倒在公路上擋路的樹。

root.note: 擋路的堆積物 → 障礙

senses.en: to force oneself or one's ideas on others; to become noticeable in an unwelcome way
senses.zh: 強加於人；冒出來惹人注意

ex.en: She tried not to obtrude her opinions on the grieving family.
ex.zh: 她盡量不把自己的意見強加給悲痛的家屬。

root.note: 往前推到人面前 → 強加於人

senses.en: noticeable in an unwelcome or unpleasant way
senses.zh: 突兀的；惹人注目的；強加於人的

ex.en: The new cell tower is an obtrusive sight in the quiet valley.
ex.zh: 新的基地台在寧靜的山谷裡顯得很突兀。

root.note: 推到人面前的 → 突兀的

senses.en: to turn something so that a different side faces the viewer; (logic) to change a statement into its equivalent negative form

ex.en: In logic class, we learned to obvert the statement "All cats are mammals" into "No cats are non-mammals."
ex.zh: 邏輯課上，我們學會把「所有貓都是哺乳類」換質成「沒有貓不是哺乳類」。

root.note: 轉向另一面

senses.en: to remove a need or difficulty; to prevent

ex.en: Online forms obviate the need to visit the office in person.
ex.zh: 線上表單讓人不必親自跑一趟辦公室。

root.note: 在路上把問題攔下 → 事先排除

senses.en: a particular time when something happens; a special event
a reason or cause
to cause

ex.en: Her graduation was a joyful occasion for the whole family.
ex.zh: 她的畢業典禮是全家人的喜事。

root.note: （事情）降臨的時刻 → 場合、時機

senses.en: the countries of the West, especially Europe and the Americas

ex.en: Silk and spices traveled from the Orient to the Occident along ancient trade routes.
ex.zh: 絲綢與香料沿著古代商路從東方運往西方。

root.note: 太陽落下的方向 → 西方

senses.en: to close up or block an opening or passage

ex.en: A blood clot can occlude an artery and cause a stroke.
ex.zh: 血塊可能會阻塞動脈而導致中風。

root.note: 對著關起來 → 堵住

senses.en: supernatural, mystical, or magical powers and practices
relating to the supernatural; secret or hidden
senses.zh: 超自然的；神祕的；隱藏的

ex.en: The old bookstore sells rare books about the occult.
ex.zh: 那家舊書店販售有關神祕學的珍本書。

root.note: 被遮蓋起來的 → 隱祕的、神祕的

senses.en: a person who lives in or uses a building, room, or vehicle

ex.en: The previous occupant of the apartment left behind a piano.
ex.zh: 這間公寓的前任住戶留下了一架鋼琴。

root.note: 占住（地方）的人 → 居住者

senses.en: an event or incident
the fact of something happening or existing

ex.en: Power outages are a rare occurrence in this neighborhood.
ex.zh: 停電在這一區是很少發生的事。

root.note: 跑到面前來的事 → 發生

senses.en: a shape with eight straight sides and eight angles

ex.en: A stop sign is shaped like a red octagon.
ex.zh: 停車標誌是紅色八角形的。

root.note: 八個角 → 八邊形

senses.en: the interval between one musical note and the note eight steps above or below it

ex.en: The soprano's voice rose a full octave in the final line.
ex.zh: 女高音在最後一句升高了整整一個八度。

root.note: 數到第八個音 → 八度

senses.en: a book size made by folding a printing sheet into eight leaves

ex.en: The collector bought a rare octavo printed in 1750.
ex.zh: 收藏家買了一本 1750 年印製的罕見八開本。

root.note: 紙張折成八頁 → 八開本

senses.en: a person between 80 and 89 years old

ex.en: The energetic octogenarian still swims a mile every morning.
ex.zh: 那位精力充沛的八旬長者每天早上仍游一英里。

parts.m: ten times 十倍（拉丁文 octogeni）

root.note: 八十幾歲的人

senses.en: relating to the eyes or vision

ex.en: The patient needed surgery to repair an ocular injury.
ex.zh: 這名病人需要動手術修復眼部傷害。

root.note: 眼睛的

senses.en: an old term for an eye doctor

ex.en: In the old story, the king sent for an oculist to treat his failing eyes.
ex.zh: 在那個古老故事裡，國王召來一位眼科醫師治療他衰退的視力。

root.note: 治療眼睛的人

senses.en: a strange or peculiar person, thing, or trait

ex.en: A snowstorm in May is an oddity in this region.
ex.zh: 五月下雪在這個地區是件怪事。

root.note: 奇怪的東西

senses.en: a lyric poem written to praise or celebrate someone or something

ex.en: Keats wrote a famous ode to a nightingale.
ex.zh: 濟慈寫過一首著名的夜鶯頌。

senses.en: extremely unpleasant; hateful

ex.en: Cleaning the fish tank was an odious chore nobody wanted.
ex.zh: 清魚缸是一件沒人想做的討厭差事。

root.note: 令人憎恨的

mn: odious（可憎的）和 odorous（有氣味的）字形相近，意思不同。

senses.en: general hatred or disgrace directed at someone because of their actions

ex.en: The company faced public odium after the oil spill.
ex.zh: 漏油事件後，這家公司遭受公眾的唾棄。

root.note: 憎恨

senses.en: giving off a smell, often a strong one

ex.en: The odoriferous cheese filled the whole refrigerator with its smell.
ex.zh: 那塊氣味濃烈的起司讓整個冰箱都是它的味道。

root.note: 帶有氣味的

senses.en: having a smell, especially a noticeable one

ex.en: Odorous gases from the swamp drifted over the village.
ex.zh: 沼澤冒出的氣體飄散到村子上空。

root.note: 有氣味的

senses.en: away from a place; so as to be removed or disconnected
away from or down from
not operating; not quite right

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
ex.zh: 離開房間時請把燈關掉。

senses.en: casual or careless in a way that seems rude
without preparation or checking

ex.en: His offhand remark about her cooking hurt her feelings.
ex.zh: 他對她廚藝隨口的一句評論傷了她的心。

root.note: 隨手丟出的 → 隨便的、即時的

senses.en: to perform official duties at a ceremony or event
to act as a referee in a sports game

ex.en: Her uncle will officiate at the wedding ceremony.
ex.zh: 她叔叔將擔任婚禮的證婚人。

root.note: 執行職務 → 主持

senses.en: too eager to give orders or offer unwanted help
senses.zh: 好管閒事的；愛發號施令的

ex.en: An officious guard insisted on checking every bag twice.
ex.zh: 一個愛擺架子的警衛堅持每個包包都要檢查兩次。

root.note: 過度盡職的 → 愛管閒事的

mn: officious 不是 official（官方的），而是「多管閒事的」。

senses.en: a side shoot growing from a plant's main stem
something that develops from something else

ex.en: The new company is an offshoot of a university research project.
ex.zh: 這家新公司是從一個大學研究計畫衍生出來的。

root.note: 從主幹長出去的芽 → 分支

senses.en: a man-eating giant in folklore
a cruel or frightening person

ex.en: In the fairy tale, a hungry ogre lives under the bridge.
ex.zh: 在童話故事中，一隻飢餓的食人妖住在橋下。

senses.en: a smooth oily substance rubbed on the skin as medicine

ex.en: Apply this ointment to the burn twice a day.
ex.zh: 這個藥膏一天擦兩次在燙傷處。

root.note: 塗抹用的東西 → 藥膏

mn: a fly in the ointment：美中不足之處。

senses.en: relating to the sense of smell

ex.en: Dogs have a far more powerful olfactory sense than humans.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅覺遠比人類敏銳。

root.note: 使聞到的 → 嗅覺的

senses.en: an offer to make peace or end a quarrel

ex.en: After the argument, she held out an olive-branch by inviting him to dinner.
ex.zh: 吵架後，她邀他吃晚餐，表示願意和解。

root.note: 橄欖枝象徵和平 → 和解的提議

mn: extend / hold out an olive branch：伸出橄欖枝，主動求和。

senses.en: suggesting that something bad is going to happen

ex.en: Ominous dark clouds gathered over the stadium before the game.
ex.zh: 比賽前，不祥的烏雲聚集在體育場上空。

root.note: 有（壞）預兆的 → 不祥的

senses.en: the act of leaving something out; something left out

ex.en: The omission of her name from the program was an honest mistake.
ex.zh: 節目單上漏掉她的名字只是無心之過。

root.note: 送走、放掉 → 省略

senses.en: unlimited or very great power

ex.en: The dictator acted as if he believed in his own omnipotence.
ex.zh: 那名獨裁者的行為彷彿他相信自己無所不能。

root.note: 擁有全部的力量 → 全能

senses.en: having unlimited power; all-powerful
(the Omnipotent) God

ex.en: In many religions, God is described as omnipotent and all-knowing.
ex.zh: 在許多宗教中，神被描述為全能且全知的。

root.note: 擁有全部力量的 → 全能的

senses.en: the state of knowing everything

ex.en: The narrator's omniscience lets readers know every character's thoughts.
ex.zh: 敘事者的全知視角讓讀者得知每個角色的想法。

root.note: 知道全部 → 全知

senses.en: knowing everything

ex.en: The story is told by an omniscient narrator who knows every secret.
ex.zh: 這個故事由一位知道所有祕密的全知敘事者講述。

root.note: 知道全部的 → 全知的

senses.en: eating both plants and animals
taking in everything available, such as all kinds of books

ex.en: Bears are omnivorous animals that eat berries, insects, and fish.
ex.zh: 熊是雜食性動物，吃莓果、昆蟲和魚。

root.note: 什麼都吃的 → 雜食性的

senses.en: involving heavy effort or responsibility; burdensome

ex.en: Caring for three young children alone is an onerous task.
ex.zh: 獨自照顧三個小孩是件繁重的工作。

root.note: 有負擔的 → 繁重的

senses.en: a sudden forward rush or flow

ex.en: The small boat was swamped by the onrush of water.
ex.zh: 小船被湧來的水淹沒了。

root.note: 向前衝 → 猛衝

senses.en: the beginning of something, especially something unpleasant

ex.en: Farmers rushed to harvest their crops before the onset of winter.
ex.zh: 農民趕在冬天來臨前收割作物。

root.note: 開始上路 → 開端

senses.en: a fierce or destructive attack
a large quantity of things arriving at once

ex.en: The singer faced an onslaught of criticism after the concert.
ex.zh: 演唱會後，那位歌手受到排山倒海的批評。

senses.en: a duty or responsibility

ex.en: The onus is on the landlord to repair the heating system.
ex.zh: 修理暖氣系統是房東的責任。

root.note: 負擔 → 責任

mn: the onus of proof：舉證責任（= burden of proof）。

senses.en: a milky, shimmering play of colors like that of an opal
senses.zh: 乳白光；貓眼石般的光彩

ex.en: The inside of the seashell had a lovely pink opalescence.
ex.zh: 貝殼內側泛著美麗的粉紅色乳白光澤。

root.note: 像蛋白石般閃爍的光澤

senses.en: not allowing light to pass through; not transparent
hard to understand; unclear

ex.en: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass for privacy.
ex.zh: 浴室窗戶用不透明玻璃，保護隱私。

senses.en: to work or function; to control a machine
to perform surgery
to manage a business or organization

ex.en: Only trained staff are allowed to operate the crane.
ex.zh: 只有受過訓練的員工才能操作起重機。

root.note: 進行工作 → 運作、操作

senses.en: functioning; in effect
a secret agent or worker

ex.en: The new law will be operative from next January.
ex.zh: 新法將從明年一月起生效。

root.note: 在運作的 → 有效的

senses.en: a person who runs a machine or business
a person who connects telephone calls

ex.en: The tour operator canceled our trip because of the storm.
ex.zh: 旅行業者因為暴風雨取消了我們的行程。

root.note: 操作的人

senses.en: a short, light opera, often comic

ex.en: The school choir performed a cheerful operetta for the holiday concert.
ex.zh: 學校合唱團在節日音樂會上演出一齣歡樂的輕歌劇。

root.note: 小型歌劇

senses.en: a view or judgment not necessarily based on fact
the formal judgment of an expert

ex.en: In my opinion, the movie was better than the book.
ex.zh: 依我看，電影比原著好看。

senses.en: a person who competes against or disagrees with another

ex.en: She shook hands with her opponent after the match.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後她和對手握手。

root.note: 放在對面的人 → 對手

senses.en: well-chosen or especially convenient for a particular action

ex.en: The rain stopped at an opportune moment, just before the ceremony began.
ex.zh: 雨在典禮開始前恰好停了。

root.note: （風）吹向港口的 → 正是時候的

senses.en: a person who takes advantage of chances, often without regard to principles

ex.en: The opportunist raised prices on water right after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 那個投機分子在地震後立刻調漲飲用水價格。

root.note: 專抓時機的人 → 機會主義者

senses.en: a time or situation that makes it possible to do something

ex.en: Studying abroad gave her the opportunity to learn Spanish.
ex.zh: 出國留學讓她有機會學西班牙文。

root.note: 順風進港的時刻 → 機會

senses.en: completely different; on the other side
a person or thing that is totally different from another
across from

ex.en: The bank is on the opposite side of the street.
ex.zh: 銀行在街道的對面。

root.note: 放在對面的 → 相反的

senses.en: harsh criticism or public disgrace caused by shameful behavior

ex.en: The company's decision to dump waste in the river drew international opprobrium.
ex.zh: 這家公司把廢棄物倒進河裡的決定招致國際譴責。

root.note: 對著人施加恥辱 → 譴責

senses.en: relating to the eye or vision

ex.en: Damage to the optic nerve can cause blindness.
ex.zh: 視神經受損可能導致失明。

root.note: 看的 → 視覺的

senses.en: a person who makes or sells glasses and contact lenses

ex.en: The optician adjusted my new glasses so they fit comfortably.
ex.zh: 配鏡師調整了我的新眼鏡，讓它戴起來很舒服。

root.note: 處理視力用具的人 → 配鏡師

senses.en: the scientific study of light and vision
the way a situation appears to the public

ex.en: Isaac Newton made important discoveries in optics.
ex.zh: 牛頓在光學上有重要的發現。

root.note: 研究看的學問 → 光學

senses.en: hopefulness and confidence about the future

ex.en: Despite the setbacks, the team remained full of optimism.
ex.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，隊伍仍然充滿樂觀。

root.note: 相信會有最好的結果 → 樂觀

senses.en: something that may be chosen; a choice
the right to buy or sell something at a set price

ex.en: Taking the train is the cheapest option.
ex.zh: 搭火車是最便宜的選擇。

root.note: 選擇

senses.en: the profession of examining eyes and prescribing glasses

ex.en: He studied optometry so he could open his own eye clinic.
ex.zh: 他攻讀視光學，好開一間自己的眼科診所。

root.note: 測量視力 → 驗光

senses.en: great wealth or luxury

ex.en: Visitors were stunned by the opulence of the palace's golden halls.
ex.zh: 遊客們被宮殿金碧輝煌的廳堂所震撼。

root.note: 財富 → 富裕、奢華

senses.en: rich and luxurious; wealthy

ex.en: They held the wedding in an opulent hotel ballroom.
ex.zh: 他們在一間豪華飯店的宴會廳舉行婚禮。

root.note: 富有的 → 奢華的

senses.en: spoken rather than written
relating to the mouth

ex.en: The final exam includes an oral presentation.
ex.zh: 期末考包含一場口頭報告。

root.note: 用嘴巴的 → 口頭的

senses.en: to make a speech, especially in a pompous way

ex.en: The candidate loved to orate about his own achievements for hours.
ex.zh: 那位候選人喜歡花好幾個小時大談自己的成就。

root.note: 開口說 → 演說

senses.en: a formal speech, especially on a ceremonial occasion

ex.en: The senator delivered a moving oration at the memorial.
ex.zh: 參議員在追悼會上發表了一篇感人的演說。

root.note: 說話 → 演說

senses.en: a skilled public speaker

ex.en: She was a gifted orator who could move a crowd to tears.
ex.zh: 她是位天賦異稟的演說家，能讓群眾感動落淚。

root.note: 演說的人

senses.en: a large musical work for orchestra and voices, usually on a religious theme, performed without costumes

ex.en: Handel's oratorio "Messiah" is performed every Christmas.
ex.zh: 韓德爾的神劇《彌賽亞》每年聖誕節都會演出。

root.note: 源自羅馬的祈禱室，當地演出宗教音樂 → 神劇

senses.en: the art of public speaking; eloquent speech
a small chapel for private prayer

ex.en: His powerful oratory helped him win the election.
ex.zh: 他強而有力的演說幫助他贏得選舉。

root.note: 說話的藝術 → 演講術；祈禱的地方 → 小禮拜堂

senses.en: a very unpleasant and difficult experience

ex.en: The hikers described their three days lost in the forest as a terrible ordeal.
ex.zh: 健行者形容他們在森林迷路三天是一場可怕的折磨。

mn: 原指中世紀的「神判法」，用火燒水淹來判定有罪與否。

senses.en: showing position in a series, such as first, second, or third

ex.en: "Third" is an ordinal number, while "three" is a cardinal number.
ex.zh: 「第三」是序數，而「三」是基數。

root.note: 表示順序的

senses.en: the ceremony of making someone a priest or minister

ex.en: His family traveled far to attend his ordination as a priest.
ex.zh: 他的家人遠道而來參加他的神父授職典禮。

root.note: 納入（神職）等級 → 授職

senses.en: military weapons, ammunition, and equipment, especially artillery

ex.en: Farmers still find unexploded ordnance in fields decades after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後數十年，農民仍在田裡發現未爆彈。

mn: ordnance（軍火）和 ordinance（法令）只差一個 i。

senses.en: (plural of orgy) wild parties with much drinking; excessive indulgence in an activity
senses.zh: （orgy 的複數）狂歡縱樂；放縱行為

senses.en: secret rites in ancient religions honoring gods such as Dionysus

ex.en: The emperor was famous for his orgies of feasting and drinking.
ex.zh: 那位皇帝以大肆飲宴作樂聞名。

senses.en: the point where something begins or comes from
a person's family background or ancestry

ex.en: Scientists are still debating the origin of the universe.
ex.zh: 科學家仍在爭論宇宙的起源。

root.note: 升起的地方 → 起源

senses.en: existing from the beginning; first
new and creative
the first version from which copies are made

ex.en: The judges praised her original design for the bridge.
ex.zh: 評審稱讚她這座橋的設計很有獨創性。

root.note: 起源的 → 原始的、獨創的

senses.en: to have a specified beginning; to start
to create or initiate

ex.en: Scholars believe that chess may originate from an ancient Indian game.
ex.zh: 學者認為西洋棋可能起源於一種古印度遊戲。

root.note: 有了起源 → 發源

senses.en: elaborately decorated
(of writing) using unusual words and complex structure

ex.en: The theater has an ornate ceiling covered in gold leaf.
ex.zh: 這座劇院有貼滿金箔的華麗天花板。

root.note: 裝飾過的 → 華麗的

senses.en: following traditional or generally accepted beliefs
(Orthodox) relating to the Eastern Orthodox Church or strict traditional Judaism
senses.zh: （大寫）東正教的；正統派猶太教的

ex.en: The doctor combined orthodox medicine with traditional herbal remedies.
ex.zh: 那位醫師將正統醫學與傳統草藥療法結合。

root.note: 正確的見解 → 正統的

senses.en: generally accepted beliefs or practices; conformity to them

ex.en: The young scientist challenged the orthodoxy of her field.
ex.zh: 那位年輕科學家挑戰了她所屬領域的正統觀念。

root.note: 正確的見解 → 正統

senses.en: at right angles; perpendicular
unrelated or independent of each other

ex.en: The two streets meet at an orthogonal angle.
ex.zh: 這兩條街呈直角相交。

root.note: 直角的 → 垂直的

senses.en: relating to the treatment of bones, joints, and muscles

ex.en: After the accident, he saw an orthopedic surgeon about his knee.
ex.zh: 車禍後，他去找骨科醫師看膝蓋。

root.note: 原指矯正兒童骨骼 → 骨科的

senses.en: a doctor who specializes in bones, joints, and muscles

ex.en: The orthopedist said my broken wrist would heal in six weeks.
ex.zh: 骨科醫師說我骨折的手腕六週就會癒合。

root.note: 矯正骨骼的醫師

senses.en: to swing back and forth regularly
to waver between different opinions or feelings

ex.en: Her mood seemed to oscillate between hope and despair.
ex.zh: 她的心情似乎在希望與絕望之間擺盪。

parts.m: swing 擺動（拉丁文 oscillum 小面具，掛著會擺動）

root.note: 來回擺動

senses.en: (humorous or formal) to kiss
(mathematics) of curves, to touch closely at a point

ex.en: The poet asked, with mock seriousness, whether he might osculate her hand.
ex.zh: 詩人故作正經地問，能否親吻她的手。

root.note: 用小嘴碰觸 → 親吻
